gloss: nice; lucky you; sounds good (Kansai dialect)

definitions.gloss: nice; lucky you; that's wonderful (Kansai dialect)
definitions.explanation: Kansai dialect expression meaning 'how nice,' 'lucky you,' or 'I'd love that.' Used to express envy, admiration, or approving agreement. The Kansai equivalent of standard いいなあ.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧ハワイ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧んや⟦って→って：29146_tte⟧。」「ええなあ、⟦{羨|うらや}ましい→羨ましい：02336_urayamashii⟧。」
examples.english: 'I hear you're going to Hawaii next month.' 'How nice! I'm jealous.'

examples.japanese: 「⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧、⟦めっちゃ→めっちゃ：04748_meccha⟧おいしい!」「ええなあ、⟦{食|た}べたい→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。」
examples.english: 'This cake is incredibly good!' 'Lucky you — I want some.'

examples.japanese: 「⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧わ。」「ええなあ、⟦こっち→こっち：02903_kocchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦{残|のこ}っ→残る：01187_nokoru⟧てる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。」
examples.english: 'I finished work early today, so I can take it easy.' 'Lucky you — I still have work left over here.'

notes:
Kansai dialect version of standard ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦なあ→なあ：29262_naa⟧. The ⟦ええ→ええ：02893_ee⟧ component is the Kansai pronunciation of ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (good, nice). The ⟦なあ→なあ：29262_naa⟧ component is an emotive final particle seeking empathy or expressing feeling.

USAGE:
- Expressing envy: ええなあ, ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧ (How nice, I want to go too)
- Approving something: ええなあ, ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよ→する：00392_suru⟧ (Sounds good, let's do that)
- Admiring something: ええなあ, ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧ (What a view!)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦なあ→なあ：29262_naa⟧ (standard): same meaning — standard Japanese equivalent
- ⟦ええやん→ええやん：07549_eeyan⟧ (→ see ⟦いいやん→いいやん：29178_iiyan⟧): that's fine/good (approval)
